info.title: Event App API
info.description: Backend for a localised, group-based event organisation and messaging app. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (user or guest session).

post.description: Email a one-time sign-in link to a guest. Always returns 202 (no account enumeration).
Exchange a magic-link token for a guest session.

Turn the current guest into a registered account. All data is kept; the guest
session is revoked and a user session is returned.

get.description: Groups the caller belongs to, most recently active first, with unread counts.
Map pins: coordinates of the caller's own groups only.

schema.title: Response Group Locations Groups Locations Get

get.description: Members' display names. Emails are only included for owners/admins.

schema.title: Response Members Groups  Group Id  Members Get

delete.description: Remove a member (owner/admin) or leave the group (your own membership id).

post.description: Invite up to 50 email addresses at once. Each receives a secure, single-use link.

schema.title: Response List Invitations Groups  Group Id  Invitations Get

post.description: What the invite landing page shows before accepting.

Accept an emailed invitation. Guests get a session back; if the email belongs to a
registered account the caller must be logged in as it (401 ``login_required``).
Accept from an in-app ``group_invite`` notification (email must match the account).

get.description: Page backwards through history with ``before_id`` (oldest message id you have).
Upcoming pinned events for the group header, soonest first.

schema.title: Response Pinned Events Groups  Group Id  Pinned Events Get

post.description:
Registered users only. Posts an interactive event message to every selected group,
pins the event and notifies group members.

get.description: Upcoming events visible to the caller (optionally for one group).

patch.description: Creator only. Participants are notified of what changed.

post.description: Share to more groups. All groups see the same participants and tasks.
Group owners/admins can pin or unpin an event in their group.

get.description: Calendar file (.ics) to add the event to Google/Apple/Outlook calendars.

schema.title: Response Participants Events  Event Id  Participants Get

delete.description: Withdraw. Unfinished tasks you had claimed are released.

schema.title: Response List Tasks Events  Event Id  Tasks Get

post.description: Participants only. 409 ``task_already_claimed`` if someone got there first.

get.description: Tasks you claimed and have not completed yet, soonest event first.

schema.title: Response My Outstanding Tasks Me Tasks Get

post.description: Mark the given notifications (or all, if ``ids`` is omitted) as read.

get.description: Free-text place search (Google Places), optionally biased towards ``lat``/``lng``.

LocationIn.title: LocationIn
LocationIn.description: A place. ``latitude``/``longitude`` must be given together.
